description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19,999. Grants [Zenith Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [Zenith Mode: Sabin II], [Attach Fire 3 with Stacking] to user.

description.name: Zenith Mode: Sabin II
description.text: Increases Fire infusion damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Sabin II after using a Fire ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Spirit Attack: Sabin II
description.text: Grants [Fire Ability Quick Cast 3], [Instant ATB 3] to user.

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action

description.name: Attach Fire 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Fire Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Fire 3
